selection_protocol.not_used_in_selection: UTC session opening-range breakout was drafted but the broad grid did not complete within the exploration runtime; no session-ORB result or metric was used for BTC9 selection
selection_protocol.selection_gate: TRAIN and DEV each have sufficient trades and PF > 1.1; total pre-validation sample >= 50; choose by TRAIN/DEV robustness before opening official validation

entry_contract.previous_day_levels: closed D1 high and low become available at the next 00:00 UTC
entry_contract.h1_trend_long: closed H1 EMA50 > EMA200, EMA200 higher than four H1 bars earlier, and EMA separation >= 0.5*H1 ATR14
entry_contract.h1_trend_short: closed H1 EMA50 < EMA200, EMA200 lower than four H1 bars earlier, and EMA separation >= 0.5*H1 ATR14
entry_contract.long_signal: first M15 close of the UTC day above the previous-day high while H1 LONG trend is true and M15 close is in the top 15 percent of the candle range
entry_contract.short_signal: first M15 close of the UTC day below the previous-day low while H1 SHORT trend is true and M15 close is in the bottom 15 percent of the candle range
entry_contract.entry: after the M15 signal closes, enter at the exact next M5 open

parameter_robustness.nearby_variants: zero or 0.1 ATR breakout buffer, 0.85 close-location threshold, 100-pip cap, and 1.1R or 1.25R all remained positive in TRAIN, DEV, and validation
parameter_robustness.selected_reason: highest minimum PF across TRAIN and DEV among the sufficient-sample previous-day breakout variants; validation was not used to select the rule
